scene.location: Culvert maintenance chamber beyond the first bend, north drainage gully outside Vespergate
scene.situation: Session 1 Turn 10. Before executing Nyxara's plan, DevilMedlar told her he wanted to talk after the confrontation regardless of whether the carver survived, sincerely apologized again for the accidental Turn 8 contact, gave Nyxara another openly sexual/flirtatious compliment about how attractive she looked while focused for a fight, wished her luck, and said he hoped they both lived through the next few moments. Nyxara accepted the apology, maintained the same consent boundary, returned dry flirtatious banter, and agreed they could talk afterward if both were standing. DevilMedlar then followed her capture plan exactly and called from cover: 'Crossbow down. Hands where I can see them. Don't touch the satchel.' Intimidation 3 + 2 = 5 against DC 13 failed. The likely carver chose to attack instead of surrendering. Initiative was carver 10, DevilMedlar 9, Nyxara 5. Nyxara's prearranged covering reaction attempted to disrupt the carver's weapon side, but 8 + 4 = 12 missed AC 13. The carver fired toward DevilMedlar as he moved from the bend; attack 3 + 3 = 6 missed DevilMedlar's effective AC 14 with corner cover. DevilMedlar immediately closed the distance according to the preauthorized nonlethal plan. Dawnclaw attack 11 + 4 = 15 hit AC 13; damage 5 + 2 = 7 bludgeoning, declared nonlethal. The blow reduced the lightly armored carver from 7 HP to 0. He is unconscious and stable, not dead. His compact crossbow fell within the chamber. The satchel remains on his body and has not yet been opened, so the probable ledger is still unverified. Combat ended after the opening exchange. DevilMedlar took no damage and spent no spell slot, Golden Breath use, Golden Ascendant use, or consumable.

clues.culvert_alarm: Known nonlethal warning alarm remains intact and armed behind DevilMedlar and Nyxara. It has not triggered.
clues.sunscale_shard: Still unidentified, unusually warm, and previously produced a brief stronger heat pulse when oriented deeper into the culvert.
clues.likely_carver_identification: The hooded adult man with shrine-stone dust and a carving chisel has now been captured alive but remains unidentified by name, exact allegiance, and motive.
clues.possible_ledger: The thick leather-bound book-sized object remains in the unconscious carver's cross-body satchel. It is consistent with Nyxara's stolen ledger description but has not yet been opened or verified.
clues.nonlethal_capture_result: Capture succeeded after failed surrender demand. Carver is unconscious and stable at 0 HP after 7 nonlethal Dawnclaw damage; DevilMedlar and Nyxara are uninjured.
clues.turn8_art_verified: Player manually uploaded art/sesion-1-turn-8-Wet-Stone-Tunnel-Stealthy-Ambush.png; repository path remains verified.
clues.nyxara_ledger_confirmation: Nyxara confirmed the woman she loves is the personally important name in the stolen Velvet Coil ledger. Identity and exact relationship remain undisclosed.
